title: Heavy Ordnance my game, now with nice water, and fully functional AH-64
author: Accomplished-Fan9568
selftext:
Game has full destruction, even the terrain is deformable/destructible and made with gemini 3.1 pro and claude opus.

I will upload the new version of the game in the coming days. :-)

[https://davydenko.itch.io/](https://davydenko.itch.io/)

comments.author: argefox
comments.body: Nice. Is it build entirely by AI or you imported external assets? Which agent/service you used?

replies.author: Accomplished-Fan9568
replies.body: Fully AI which is why the whole game is pure code and not even 1Mb size :-)
